name: Shops by Airport
query:
SELECT
	airport.name AS "Airport:Link/Airport:200",
	COUNT(shop.name) AS "Total Shops:Int:120",
	SUM(CASE WHEN shop.status = 'Available' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Available:Int:100",
	SUM(CASE WHEN shop.status = 'Occupied' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Occupied:Int:100"
FROM `tabAirport` airport
LEFT JOIN `tabShop` shop ON shop.airport = airport.name
GROUP BY airport.name
ORDER BY COUNT(shop.name) DESC
